LanguageData.RP_WardenWord_GangDealDesc: Offer the gang a quiet wing for {0} days, against one thing of the leader's pick. They may take it, or refuse and think the less of the warden. A deal is a mark against the prison (the inspector scores it {1} points lower while it runs, and the press may tell it).
LanguageData.RP_WardenWord_GangDealTold: {0} sat down with {1} and put the terms on the table.
LanguageData.RP_GangDealWhy_Gone: the leader is not who they were
LanguageData.RP_GangDealWhy_NoVisits: no family, or no visitation room
LanguageData.RP_GangDealWhy_NoJob: nobody fit for a free job
LanguageData.RP_GangDealOfferLabel: The {0}, a deal for a quiet wing
LanguageData.RP_GangDealOfferText: {0} leads the {1}. The warden can offer them a quiet wing for {2} days. Their members on {0}'s wing misbehave {3} less, they start no war and take in nobody, and the other gangs on that wing are wound up by it (the {1} run the yard). The price is that the inspector scores the prison {4} points lower while it runs, and the press may hear of it. A fight or an assault the {1} are seen in breaks it.\n\nThe leader wants one thing for it, the warden's pick of four. {0} takes the deal with a {5} chance, which their trust of the warden moves, and a refusal costs that trust.
LanguageData.RP_GangDeal_Turf: A patch of yard or common room, as turf
LanguageData.RP_GangDeal_Visits: Two visits a week for its members
LanguageData.RP_GangDeal_Commissary: The commissary open to its members
LanguageData.RP_GangDeal_Job: A job slot for a member the leader names
LanguageData.RP_GangDealRefused: {0} will not strike a deal for the {1}, and thinks the less of {2} for asking.
LanguageData.RP_GangDealTerm_Visits: two visits a week for its members
LanguageData.RP_GangDealTerm_Commissary: the commissary open to its members
LanguageData.RP_Chr_GangDealStart: The warden struck a deal with {0} of the {1}, a quiet wing for {2} days against {3}.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_GangDealEnd_Lapsed: The deal with {0} of the {1} ran out. The terms are back to the usual rules.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_GangDealEnd_Warden: The warden called off the deal with {0} of the {1}, who think the less of the warden for it.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_GangDealEnd_Breach: The {1} broke the deal a second time and the warden called it off, to the displeasure of {0}.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_GangDealEnd_Gone: The deal with {0} of the {1} fell through. The leader is gone, no longer leads, or is off the wing the deal was struck on.
LanguageData.RP_Chr_GangDealOverlooked: The warden overlooked a breach of the deal with {0} of the {1}, this once.
LanguageData.RP_GangDealBreachText:
{0} of the {1} was seen in a fight, and the deal with {2} was for a quiet wing, against {3}.

Overlook it, this once - the next breach ends the deal with no word.
End the deal - the terms are taken back, and {2} will not forget it.
LanguageData.RP_PressTopicGangDeal: {0} of the {1} has the run of the wing, and the warden made it so.
LanguageData.RP_IntelTip_GangDeal: The warden's deal with the {0}'s leader. Its members on the leader's wing misbehave less, the gang starts no war and takes in nobody, and the inspector scores the prison lower while it runs. A second breach ends it.
LanguageData.RP_IntelGangDealEndConfirm: End the warden's deal with {0} of the {1}? The terms are taken back, {0} thinks the less of the warden for it, and there is no new deal with the gang for {2} days.
LanguageData.RP_IntelTip_GangDealEnd: End the deal now. The terms are taken back, the leader thinks the less of the warden, and no new deal with the gang for {0} days.
